exposure: Patients who underwent the folding suture method
Patients who underwent the muscle flap filling suture method
Folding suture method vs. Muscle flap filling suture method
outcome: Thickness of the lower uterine segment
cohort: 24 patients with cesarean scar diverticulum who underwent surgery
finding: Both the laparoscopic 'muscle flap filling suture method' and 'folding suture method' combined with hysteroscopic incision are safe and effective treatments for repairing CSD, preserving uterine integrity.
